definitions.explanation: A small dish served at the beginning of a meal to stimulate the appetite. In Japanese cuisine, often consists of several small seasonal items.

examples.japanese: {前菜|ぜんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いします：00981_onegaishimasu⟧。
⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{前菜|ぜんさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Appetizers are served first in a course meal.

examples.japanese: {前菜|ぜんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{綺麗|きれい}→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The appetizer assortment looks beautiful too.

examples.japanese: {前菜|ぜんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られています→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The appetizers are small in portion, but each one is carefully prepared.

examples.japanese: ⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前菜|ぜんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{生|なま}ハム→生ハム：noentry⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Italian appetizers often include prosciutto and cheese.

notes:
{前菜|ぜんさい} (literally "before-dish") refers to appetizers or starters.

{前|ぜん} = before, {菜|さい} = dish/vegetable

In Japanese cuisine:
- Often called ⟦{先付|さきづ}け→先付け：24507_sakizuke⟧ in kaiseki
- Features multiple small, seasonal items
- Emphasizes visual presentation
- Designed to stimulate appetite

In Western-style restaurants:
- ⟦オードブル→オードブル：noentry⟧ (hors d'oeuvre)
- ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧ (salad)
- ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧ (soup)

Meal structure:
- {前菜|ぜんさい} (appetizer)
- ⟦{主菜|しゅさい}→主菜：04995_shusai⟧ (main dish)
- ⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧ (side dish)
- ⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧ (soup)
- ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧ (staple/rice)
